recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is and do not reintroduce Reference :in. The current _in design is the later approved syntax and already conveys the intended membership-search behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-22690 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested a Reference-search :in modifier for List and Group membership, e.g. Encounter?patient:in=Group/123, with enumerated Group membership preferred and characteristic-only Groups dependent on server support.
initial_application: No commit explicitly cites FHIR-22690. Commit 652ee3df4866d4910bf9d0573677f5a5183cea45 implicitly added Reference :in semantics, List.entry.item/Group.member.entity prose, and the Encounter?patient:in=Group example to source/search.html. Later FHIR-37846 commits 3e70503739324804fad2ddfc1a424e1e6b4e6692, e6032af6c9cbf233e1a804e87310b81fb8937fe5, and ddecc63591d23dab5767aa2888c985a7c75964b6 replaced that draft syntax with Resource-_in.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread and 2019 FHIR-I minutes confirm the List/Group membership-search motivation. FHIR-23724, from the same discussion, clarified Group membership basis and is already audited on the combined branch. FHIR-37846 later superseded the syntax by replacing Reference :in with _in while retaining _list, and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 410f08e1be763424d9b1528ff54d9c1c6efbf10a.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current source/search.html defines _in as a reference search parameter for active membership in CareTeam, Group, or List and includes the Encounter?patient._in=Group example; source/resource/bundle-Resource-search-params.xml defines Resource-_in as reference over Resource.id with CareTeam, Group, and List targets; source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-modifier-code.xml keeps in token-only for ValueSet membership.

related_jiras.note: Replaced the draft Reference :in modifier with the standard _in search parameter while preserving Group/List membership search; already represented on the combined branch by 410f08e1be763424d9b1528ff54d9c1c6efbf10a.

Same Zulip discussion led to Group.membership basis clarification for characteristic-defined versus enumerated Groups; already represented on the combined branch by bbcd2a06b460ae53e1fec1f0eacada57f2dff42b.
